**Severity:** error · **Area:** Styles (`RV5xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
style strings are not supported: use a style object (style={{ color: c, "--x": v }}) or style:color={c}
```

```text
Use one class attribute (class or className) per element
```

```text
Unsafe style value for {property}: url(), src(), image-set(), expression(), javascript: and \ ; { } /* are not allowed in style values
```

```text
Invalid style property: {key}
```

```text
style:{key} needs a value
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use a style object or `style:prop={v}` instead of a style string, one class attribute per element, and no `url()/expression()` in inline style values (use a class).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <p style="color: red" />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <p style={{ color: "red" }} />;
```

## When it is reported

'Invalid style property' / 'needs a value' variants lack hints.
